basic_details.organization_name: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC) – Ekatmik Arogya Kutumb Kalyan Society
basic_details.short_information: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC), through the Ekatmik Arogya Kutumb Kalyan Society, has invited applications for 56 Medical Officer (MBBS) posts under the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM), funded by the 15th Finance Commission for Urban Health Centres. These are purely contractual, fixed-honorarium positions filled through a direct walk-in interview scheduled for August 5, 2026, at the NMMC Health Department, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai.

Candidates aged 60 years or above are required to submit a physical and mental fitness certificate issued by the District Surgeon along with their application.

selection_process: Selection for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post is made directly through a walk-in interview; there is no written examination. Candidates must report for registration
and verification between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM on the interview date

followed by the interview on the same day. Merit lists for Urban Health Centres functioning under the 15th Finance Commission are prepared based on the priority order in which the centres become operational. Eligible candidates from the merit list are called for document verification; appointment orders are issued only after successful verification of original documents. Selected candidates must report for duty at the assigned Urban Health Centre within 7 days of the appointment order; failure to do so
or use of undue influence/pressure tactics
will result in cancellation of selection
and the position will be offered to the next eligible candidate on the waiting list.
important_instructions: These are purely contractual posts and not regular Maharashtra Government posts; candidates cannot claim regularization or absorption into regular government service on this basis. All updates and information related to this recruitment will be published only on the official NMMC website, https://www.nmmc.gov.in; no individual personal communication will be made to candidates. Mere submission or acceptance of an application does not guarantee selection; candidature can be cancelled at any stage if the candidate is found ineligible or has furnished incorrect information. OBC/VJ/NT/SBC/SEBC candidates must submit a valid non-creamy layer certificate; applications without this will be rejected. Backward class candidates applying under reservation must attach a caste certificate; otherwise the application will be treated as ineligible for reservation benefits. Candidates must submit an affidavit declaring that no criminal case is registered against them. Small family norms are applicable with effect from 23.07.2020; candidates having more than two children born on or after this date are not eligible to apply. Working hours at the Urban Health Centres under the 15th Finance Commission scheme are from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM. The Commissioner, NMMC, reserves all rights to postpone, cancel, or modify the recruitment process, including the number of posts, at any stage; no claims will be entertained in this regard. Photographs must be recent, clear, and pasted (not stapled) in the designated space on the application; signature must be provided in the designated space.

Candidates holding an MBBS qualification can also explore more Medical Officer Government Jobs and Maharashtra Health Department Jobs available across India. Applicants looking for more opportunities under the National Health Mission can check the latest NUHM/NHM Recruitment Notifications across various states. Those searching for openings closer to Mumbai can also browse Navi Mumbai Government Jobs and Maharashtra Government Jobs 2026 matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: NMMC Medical Officer (MBBS) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: MBBS degree from a recognized university. Registration with the Maharashtra Medical Council (or equivalent recognized medical council, as applicable) is mandatory. The qualification must have been obtained from a university/institution recognized by the Government. Maximum age: 70 years, as per the circular of the Mission Director, National Urban Health Mission, dated 25.05.2019, calculated as on the last date of application. Candidates aged 60 years or above are required to submit a physical and mental fitness certificate issued by the District Surgeon along with their application.

content_sections.heading: NMMC Medical Officer (MBBS) 2026 Honorarium
content_sections.text: This is a fixed monthly honorarium paid under a contractual engagement; it is not a regular pay scale. The engagement is for a period of 6 months, as specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: NMMC Medical Officer (MBBS) Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee has been specified in the notification for this walk-in recruitment.

content_sections.heading: NMMC Medical Officer (MBBS) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post is made directly through a walk-in interview; there is no written examination. Candidates must report for registration, document scrutiny, and verification between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM on the interview date, followed by the interview on the same day. Merit lists for Urban Health Centres functioning under the 15th Finance Commission are prepared based on the priority order in which the centres become operational. Eligible candidates from the merit list are called for document verification; appointment orders are issued only after successful verification of original documents. Selected candidates must report for duty at the assigned Urban Health Centre within 7 days of the appointment order; failure to do so, or use of undue influence/pressure tactics, will result in cancellation of selection, and the position will be offered to the next eligible candidate on the waiting list.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NMMC Medical Officer (MBBS) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Age proof (10th certificate / school leaving certificate) Mark sheets and certificates of educational qualification (MBBS) Maharashtra Medical Council registration certificate (as applicable) Experience certificates from government, semi-government, or private institutions, clearly stating the type of employer, post held, and joining/relieving dates Caste certificate, for candidates applying under a reserved category Non-creamy layer certificate (with valid date), for OBC/VJ/NT/SBC/SEBC category candidates Domicile certificate (proof of Maharashtra residency) Aadhaar card PAN card Recent passport-size photograph Marriage registration certificate (if married) or Gazette notification (if name changed) Small family certificate/affidavit Affidavit declaring no criminal case is registered against the candidate

content_sections.heading: How to Attend the NMMC Medical Officer (MBBS) Walk-in Interview 2026
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the prescribed application format as specified in the notification. Fill in the application accurately with personal, educational, and category-related details. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents listed above with the application. Report to the Aarogya Vibhag, 3rd Floor, NMMC Head Office, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai, on 05.08.2026 between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM for registration. Carry all original documents along with self-attested copies for scrutiny and verification; candidates who do not produce original documents will be declared ineligible. Appear for the direct interview, conducted on the same day following document verification.
